role: Villager breeding: two adult villagers of a village in mating season (doors * 0.35 not yet filled) walk together for up to 300 ticks and a child spawns when both are mating and touching.

members.name: villagerObj
members.note: folded: the task runs on the villager itself (struct living); is_mating lives on it

members.name: worldObj
members.note: folded: reached through the owning an_world

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: AIC_VILLAGER_MATE case: growingAge == 0, rand(500), findNearestVillage(0), the doors*0.35 census, then the nearest adult villager in the 8x3x8 box

members.name: resetTask
members.note: clears the village and mate, setMating(false)

members.name: continueExecuting
members.note: matingTimeout >= 0 and the doors census and growingAge == 0

members.name: updateTask
members.note: --matingTimeout, look 10/30, walks at 0.25 beyond 1.5 blocks, giveBirth at timeout 0 with a mating partner, the 1-in-35 heart draw kept for RNG order

members.name: checkSufficientDoorsPresentForNewVillager
members.note: inlined: isMatingSeason and num_villagers < (int)(num_doors * 0.35) in both the should and continue paths

members.name: giveBirth
members.note: createChild (villagers.c:villager_create_child), setGrowingAge(6000) on both parents, the child's -24000 and setLocationAndAngles at the parent, spawnEntityInWorld; the setEntityState(12) heart call is empty in the oracle; village-life-s42 (three births)
